cases.name: ordinary Rust sync handshake and absent capability leave remote durability unknown and outbox pending
negotiated actual relay commit prunes only pending membership and preserves recovery journal
receipt documentId mismatch cannot prune or claim remoteCommitted
receipt epoch mismatch cannot prune or claim remoteCommitted
receipt schema mismatch cannot prune or claim remoteCommitted
receipt writerId mismatch cannot prune or claim remoteCommitted
receipt sequence mismatch cannot prune or claim remoteCommitted
receipt checksum mismatch cannot prune or claim remoteCommitted
receipt updateId mismatch cannot prune or claim remoteCommitted
denied authorization keeps offline commands editable and recovery export available without upload
service revocation stops upload and baseline traffic while retaining edits for authorized reconnect
late committed response after revocation is fenced; reconnect resends idempotently
receipt transaction abort cannot publish remoteCommitted or prune
new local commit during durable upload restarts the bounded replay cursor
unsupported negotiation and wrong peer identity fail before replacing an authorized connection
malformed non-durable receipts fail admission and capability absence ignores even a valid receipt
durable replay is bounded to one page per event without dropping the remaining local backlog
